Move counter-clockwise around the round wooden table at a constant 2-metre radius, completing one full circle in exactly 10 seconds, continuously looking at the tabletop centre. Constant speed, no head bobbing or roll. The table, chairs, red toaster, dark mug, white plate, white bowl, knife and tall table lamp remain static. One fixed bright sun lights the scene; its world direction, intensity and colour temperature remain constant throughout.
